newsitem.title: UK: Last three Oct Brent cargoes kept - trade.
newsitem.headline: Last three Oct Brent cargoes kept - trade.

text.p: The last three October Brent cargoes due to turn wet were all kept ahead of the five o'clock deadline on Monday, traders said.
The three cargoes loading October 29-31 were kept by British Petroleum, J.P. Morgan and Neste, they added.
Benchmark Dated Brent was offered on Monday at Nov Brent paper less five cents a barrel, in line with the last reported deal. Early bids came from Nov Brent less 10 cents, traders said.
